dinner.vibe: Beachfront Cala Tarida table with produce from its own garden, sunbeds by the water, and open kitchen hours into the evening.

images.alt: View from Can Yucas terrace over Cala Tarida bay and beach

dance.name: 528 Ibiza
dance.vibe: Outdoor hillside day-party venue near San Antonio (IRG), known for open-air garden parties.

dance.name: [UNVRS]
dance.vibe: Hyperclub on the former Privilege site in San Rafael; DJ Mag #1 club in its debut year (2025), large indoor/outdoor production.

dance.name: Akasha Las Dalias
dance.vibe: Boutique club space at Las Dalias in San Carlos, combining open-air garden fiestas with indoor tech-house sessions.

dance.name: Amnesia
dance.vibe: Ibiza institution with Main Room and Terraza, known for techno and diverse electronic programming.

dance.name: Bam-Bu-Ku
dance.vibe: Lower-key family-friendly day club neighbouring O Beach in San Antonio.

dance.name: Café del Mar
dance.vibe: Famous San Antonio sunset bar on the Sunset Strip, long associated with chill-out and sunset sessions.

dance.name: Chinois Ibiza
dance.vibe: Intimate upscale club in Ibiza Marina with 1920s Shanghai styling and a formal dress code.

dance.name: Cova Santa
dance.vibe: Amnesia-owned hillside venue in San José with restaurant, outdoor stage and small downstairs club space.

dance.name: Destino Five Ibiza
dance.vibe: Pacha Group adults resort near Talamanca with outdoor stage parties and exclusive Tox club space.

dance.name: Es Paradis
dance.vibe: Long-running San Antonio club under a glass pyramid, known for the Fiesta del Agua water party.

dance.name: Hï Ibiza
dance.vibe: Playa d'en Bossa superclub by The Night League with Theatre and Club Room spaces and major production.

dance.name: Ibiza Rocks Pool Club
dance.vibe: Open-air pool party venue in San Antonio aimed at a younger crowd, with Daylife Pass entry option.

dance.name: Lío Ibiza
dance.vibe: Marina cabaret restaurant that transforms into a late-night dancefloor after dinner shows.

dance.name: Mint Lounge
dance.vibe: Mambo-owned Sunset Strip lounge alternative to Café Mambo for cocktails and sunset views.

dance.name: Nocturna
dance.vibe: Intimate no-phones boutique club in Cala de Bou — audiophile sound, refined design, community-first dancefloor beneath Los Felices.

dance.name: O Beach Ibiza
dance.vibe: San Antonio coastal day club with rotating pool parties, choreographed shows and VIP beds.

dance.name: Pacha Ibiza
dance.vibe: Iconic Ibiza Town nightclub since 1973, known for its cherry brand and glamorous electronic music nights.

dance.name: Pikes
dance.vibe: Historic boutique hotel club near San Antonio (over-27 guest list), known for intimate Freddie's discotheque parties.

dance.name: Playa Soleil
dance.vibe: Beachfront restaurant and late-night club on Playa d'en Bossa, modern successor vibe to Bora Bora.

dance.name: Sundara
dance.vibe: Intimate ~380-cap basement club at The Palm Star Hotel in San Antonio Bay; Promised Land Wednesdays.

dance.name: SWAG Ibiza
dance.vibe: R&B and hip-hop specialist club next to Hotel Garbi in Playa d'en Bossa, popular with locals.

dance.name: Ushuaïa Ibiza
dance.vibe: Open-air daytime superclub opposite Hï, known for festival-scale stage production and mainstream electronic parties.

dance.name: Eden Ibiza
dance.vibe: San Antonio Bay club with Void sound — a global electronic music icon closest to Ibiza’s legendary sunsets.
